reply: Sentimos muito que você esteja encontrando erros de gramática, tradução e pronúncia no curso de alemão. Isso atrapalha justamente quem quer praticar com atenção. Se puder, reporte as frases erradas na própria lição ou envie exemplos para {support_contact}, para que possam ser corrigidas.
Schade, dass dir die wechselnden App-Icons so wenig gefallen, dass du die App wieder deinstallierst. Wir verstehen, dass so etwas auf dem Startbildschirm stört. Dein Feedback geht an das Team weiter.

Thank you! Learning a little every day is exactly how progress adds up, and we're glad {app_name} fits into your routine.

Thank you for sharing how strongly this decision affects you and students in Iran. We understand how disappointing it is when access to a test people rely on is restricted. For questions about eligibility for the {app_name} English Test, please contact {support_contact}.

Sorry your streak didn't go up even though you practised, that's really discouraging. Please contact {support_contact} with your device, app version and the dates it happened, so the team can look into your streak.
Sorry to hear the new way to level up feels so much worse to you. Changes to how progress works can be frustrating, and your feedback is shared with the team.

Danke, dass dir die App gefällt! Dass das Programm hängt und du nicht weiterkommst, tut uns leid. Schreib bitte an {support_contact} mit Gerät und App-Version, dann kann das Team dem Problem nachgehen.
Pode ficar tranquilo: sua família está a salvo, mesmo sem a lição de hoje. Descanse bem e volte a praticar quando puder.

We hear how disappointed you are, and we understand why this feels at odds with the goal of making education available to everyone. Questions about access to the {app_name} English Test can be sent to {support_contact}.
Sorry {app_name} has been more frustrating than fun for you lately. If a specific part of the app is causing it, let us know at {support_contact} so the team can take a look.
Obrigado pelo feedback detalhado! Percebemos que é frustrante ver respostas marcadas como erradas por usar português de Portugal em vez do Brasil. Vamos partilhar o seu comentário com a equipa.

Lamentamos que los anuncios y los recordatorios te hayan resultado molestos e incluso de miedo. Si la aplicación se cierra sola, escríbenos a {support_contact} con tu dispositivo y la versión de la app para revisarlo.
¡Muchas gracias! Nos alegra mucho que disfrutes usando la app. ¡Sigue así con tus lecciones!
Gracias por tu comentario. Entendemos que a veces las metas y los recordatorios pueden sentirse demasiado exigentes, y compartimos tu opinión con el equipo.
星4つの評価ありがとうございます。日本語からベトナム語を学べるコースをご希望とのこと、貴重なご意見としてチームに共有いたします。引き続き学習をお楽しみください。
Muito obrigado! Ficamos felizes em saber que você está aprendendo com a gente. Continue assim!

Sí leemos las reseñas, y lamentamos que el sistema de energía te frustre después de tantos años aprendiendo con nosotros. Entendemos que cortar la práctica a los pocos minutos quita las ganas de volver. Compartimos tu opinión con el equipo.

Danke, dass du schon so lange dabei bist! Wir verstehen, dass ständige Angebote für Max nerven, wenn du bereits Super nutzt, und dass sich 70 Aufgaben in der Monatsaufgabe wie eine Strafe anfühlen. Dein Feedback geht an das Team.
Thank you, we're glad you're enjoying learning with {app_name}! If anything is holding back the other stars, we'd love to hear about it.
詳しいご意見ありがとうございます。フラッシュカードやリリーとの会話が難しすぎること、レベル2でピンインがなくなるのが早すぎることへのご不満、よく理解できます。内容はチームに共有いたします。返金のご相談は{support_contact}までご連絡ください。

We're so sorry a spelling exercise made you sad and that you lost your streak. It's completely okay to find spelling hard at 10. Every lesson you try still helps you learn, and you can always start a new streak.
ご意見ありがとうございます。連続記録やランキングで罪悪感をあおられるのがつらいこと、アイコンの変更が不要に感じられることを受け止めました。内容を評価していただけて嬉しいです。いただいた声はチームに共有します。

Thank you for five years of learning with us, and for explaining what has changed for you. Ads that are hard to close and a heavy focus on leagues can take the fun out of learning, and we've shared your feedback with the team.
Sorry your app doesn't feel as cool as your friend's! We've shared your feedback with the team, and we hope you keep enjoying your lessons.

Sorry the app crashes every time you open it on your iPhone Air, especially after you've already tried reinstalling and restarting. Please contact {support_contact} with your iOS and app version so the team can investigate.
